rule.message:
University of Minnesota Twin Cities students must meet the following criteria for admission to the Sport Management major:
GPA: 2.5 preferred; 2.0 required
45 credits completed or in progress
SMGT 1701 completed
3  of the 4 remaining categories completed or in progress. First Year Experience (EDHD 1525W) is only required for incoming freshmen, this is not required for transfer students. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

All students must complete the University's Liberal Education requirements .
Collegiate Requirements:
All incoming CEHD Freshman must complete the First-Year Experience course.
At least 18 upper-division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
